mapper.select: SELECT refund_id FROM refund_delivery WHERE state IN ('READY','WAITING') AND next_publish_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND next_run_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY next_publish_at,refund_id LIMIT 25 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_delivery SET next_publish_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),INTERVAL 5 SECOND) WHERE refund_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT refund_id,attempt_no,state,lease_token,lease_until,next_run_at,deadline_at,query_count,submit_count,last_error,ticket_id FROM refund_delivery WHERE refund_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_delivery SET lease_token=#{token},lease_until=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),INTERVAL 30 SECOND) WHERE refund_id=#{id} AND state IN ('READY','WAITING') AND next_run_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
UPDATE refund_delivery SET query_count=query_count+1 WHERE refund_id=#{id} AND lease_token=#{token}
UPDATE refund_delivery SET submit_count=submit_count+1 WHERE refund_id=#{id} AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND state IN ('READY','WAITING')
UPDATE refund_delivery SET state='DONE',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL WHERE refund_id=#{id} AND attempt_no=#{attempt}

UPDATE refund_delivery SET state='WAITING',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL, next_run_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),next_publish_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), deadline_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),INTERVAL 10 MINUTE),last_error=NULL WHERE refund_id=#{id} AND state='MANUAL'
mapper.select: SELECT o.customer_id,a.session_public_id AS session_id FROM refund_request r JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=r.order_id LEFT JOIN chat_action a ON a.public_id=r.public_id WHERE r.id=#{id}
